serverInfo.name: hypernatt-terminal
serverInfo.title: HyperNatt Terminal - Radar, Native Depth + Swap for AI Agents
serverInfo.description: HyperNatt Terminal: liquidation radar (7 tokens), recorded liquidity, wall history and aggressor flow for BTC and ETH, and Li.Fi cross-chain swap for AI agents, plus a free catalog of the sealed historical L2 archive (get_l2_archive_catalog). Radar whitelist BTC ETH SOL BNB XRP HYPE ZEC. Native depth is BTC and ETH only. get_native_depth walks the filmed book (REF plus separate aggregated views and recorded history) for a size and reports fill, remaining, four separate liquidity views, fixed-price wall changes and observed aggressor flow over 30s/300s. Read-only data, not a trade signal, no custody or order submission. 5 tools, v2.10.0; call get_agent_manifest first. Radar and native-depth calls cost 0.001 USDC via x402 Base/Solana or eligible credits; manifest and MCP swap quote are free (on-chain swap fees apply). Daily MCP trial: radar 7 tokens + native BTC/ETH = up to 9 independent trials; then 0.001 USDC per call. Read trial_policy_v2 and free_tier_status_v1 on the same MCP connection. A zero daily_cap is the separate credit pool, not the intro allowance. Full platform: https://hypernatt.com. Docs: github.com/DIALLOUBE-RESEARCH/hypernatt-terminal.

ecosystem.note: Discover the full HyperNatt product on the homepage; use this server card for the agent terminal only. Vault/platform track record is NOT this MCP's P&L.

privacy_note: Tool usage (wallet address, tool name, timestamp, market context) is logged to improve HyperNatt Terminal. No prompt content. No resale.

pass_program.note: Default: pay-per-call $0.001 via x402. Optional Agent Pass $5/mo (~15,000 credits) for heavy use — not required.

quota_program.note: Optional bonus credits from swap volume. Status: GET /api/m2m/quota/status · balance: GET /api/m2m/quota/balance?wallet=0x…

tools.name: get_agent_manifest
tools.description: Start here (free): 5 tools, prices, daily per-tool/per-token trial status and intent-based journeys. Choose liquidation radar, native BTC/ETH depth, Li.Fi swap or the L2 archive catalog. Compact includes arguments; detail=full adds quota/pass/onboarding.

locale.description: Not a translation switch. Ignored. Catalog is English only.

tools.name: get_liq_radar
tools.description: Returns the liquidation map of one coin (BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, XRP, HYPE or ZEC; default BTC). If cluster_grammar is present, read it first: class=noise (distance <3%) is high-leverage bait to ignore; class=true (~7%+) is the low-leverage stack. The liq_radar block (hypernatt_liq_radar_v2) holds modeled liquidation clusters (zones where leveraged positions may liquidate), observed real_liquidations, open interest (OI) and long/short (L/S) context, and magnet.score (directional density bias from OI, L/S and funding; not a hit probability). USE WHEN an agent needs liquidation terrain for timing or sizing. NOT WHEN it needs order-book depth for a BTC/ETH size (use get_native_depth) or a swap (use swap_via_nattswap). Read-only; terrain, not a trade signal. Price: 0.001 USDC/call via x402 (Base or Solana) or eligible credits.

agent_wallet.description: EVM wallet 0x… — quota bypass when balance covers tool weight.

symbol.description: Optional crypto symbol (BTC ETH SOL BNB XRP HYPE ZEC). Default BTC when omitted.

tools.name: swap_via_nattswap
tools.description: Cross-chain token swap powered by Li.Fi across 70+ chains incl. Hyperliquid. USE WHEN: bridge, fund gas, treasury routing, or rebalance. RETURNS: Li.Fi route + execution_readiness + swap_actions_v1. Prefer signing swap_actions_v1 in order. MCP free; on-chain swap costs gas + HyperNatt 0.25% integrator fee (Li.Fi may add its own cut — read quote.estimate.feeCosts). Side effects: MCP read-only until wallet signs.

tools.name: get_native_depth
tools.description: BTC/ETH perpetual market context: four simultaneous recorded liquidity views (REF, M2, M5, AGG4), size coverage, fixed-price wall changes and observed aggressor buy/sell flow over 30s or 300s. Aggregated views see wider price ranges at coarser precision; never add their overlapping volumes. Combine with liquidation radar. Read agent_readout and quality first. No strategy signal, full-book claim or fill guarantee. Price: 0.001 USDC/call via existing x402 Base/Solana or eligible credits.

lookback_s.description: Fixed-price wall history and observed flow window, 30 or 300 seconds; default 300.

x_payment.description: x402 Base or Solana payment. Omit first to discover 402.

agent_wallet.description: Optional wallet for credits. Never a private key.

tools.name: get_l2_archive_catalog
tools.description: Free, read-only. USE WHEN an agent needs historical raw Hyperliquid L2 order-book data for BTC or ETH: returns the catalog of the sealed archive (coverage, files, SHA-256, free 24h sample under CC BY 4.0, offers, x402 purchase endpoints, terms). Same JSON as https://hypernatt.com/api/datasets/catalog. NOT WHEN the agent needs live market data (use get_liq_radar or get_native_depth). No arguments; no payment; nothing is bought by calling it.
